# Research Protocol Power

*Generated by `research/analysis/research_power.py`. This file is generated;
re-run the script rather than editing it.*

## Question

If the search contains one genuinely edged candidate and the rest are worthless, 
how often does the protocol both select the real candidate and approve it on a fresh OOS check?

## Assumptions

- Runs: 50,000, seed: 20260827.
- Sharpe estimate standard error: 0.45.
- Fresh OOS acceptance Sharpe proxy: 1.09.
- Development selection noise and OOS validation noise are independent.

## Power by true Sharpe

| True Sharpe | Power, single pre-specified candidate | Trials affordable at >=10% power |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 0.4 | 6.3% | none |
| 0.6 | 13.8% | 1 |
| 1.0 | 42.1% | 1 |

## Search penalty

| True Sharpe | Trials | P(real candidate selected) | P(real candidate approved) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0.4 | 1 | 100.0% | 6.4% |
| 0.4 | 10 | 30.6% | 1.8% |
| 0.4 | 100 | 6.7% | 0.4% |
| 0.4 | 1,000 | 1.2% | 0.1% |
| 0.6 | 1 | 100.0% | 13.8% |
| 0.6 | 10 | 45.0% | 6.2% |
| 0.6 | 100 | 14.1% | 2.0% |
| 0.6 | 1,000 | 3.7% | 0.6% |
| 1.0 | 1 | 100.0% | 42.1% |
| 1.0 | 10 | 74.1% | 31.4% |
| 1.0 | 100 | 39.9% | 16.5% |
| 1.0 | 1,000 | 17.0% | 7.2% |

## Protocol implication

- The protocol is good at suppressing false positives, but it has low power at the Sharpe range
  V1 itself predicts. A failed V1 gate is therefore weak evidence against the mechanism unless
  the experiment was tightly pre-specified and the trial count stayed tiny.
- Larger searches are not free. They reduce the chance that the real candidate is even selected
  before the fresh OOS gate sees it.
- This supports the zero-fitted-parameter V1 design and argues for an append-only trial ledger
  before any parameter search is allowed to expand.

## DSR placement bug caught by this analysis

Selection-bias correction belongs where selection occurred: the development/selection sample.
Applying a Deflated Sharpe search correction again to a fresh OOS estimate double-counts the
penalty. In this calibration, the misapplied OOS gate would require an OOS Sharpe above
2.90, which would reject practically every plausible crypto trend edge.
